n_hook.text: Jet Up, TAG Markets, Copy X, Sonic AI. Four names, plus you. Mix them up, and nothing makes sense. Here's one picture you'll never forget.

n_taxi.text: Think of a minibus taxi. You don't drive. You choose a driver, take your seat, and the driver does the driving. Copy trading works the same way.

n_driver.text: Sonic AI is the driver. It does the trading.

n_seat.text: Your seat is booked in your name. That's your TAG Markets account.

n_board.text: Copy X is the route board that puts you in that driver's taxi.

n_assoc.text: Jet Up is the association. It trains and organises the passengers.

n_you.text: And you? You decide which taxi to take, and how much to put in.

n_stops.text: Here's where the picture stops. A taxi gets you there. A strategy can lose money, and a good last trip never promises the next one.
